<translate>
<!--T:1-->
DragonMineZ ships its '''own melee combat system''', similar in spirit to ''Better Combat'': every weapon has a hand-crafted '''moveset''' instead of a single generic swing. This page explains that system and compares the signature weapons that use it.
</translate>

<translate>
== The combat system == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Each weapon is bound to a '''moveset''': a '''combo chain''' of attacks that you cycle through as you keep swinging, each with its own '''reach, sweep angle, timing (wind-up) and damage'''.

<!--T:12-->
* '''Combos:''' consecutive attacks step through the moveset (attack 1, 2, 3…) and loop. Different weapon classes swing, sweep and reach very differently.
* '''Dual-wielding:''' hold a weapon in each hand and your combo alternates hands automatically.
* '''Reach:''' each moveset has its own range (a staff out-reaches a sword), on top of your entity reach.
* '''Stamina:''' swinging, blocking and dashing all cost Stamina (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]]).
* '''Blocking and parrying:''' you can block (up to about 65% damage reduction) and '''parry''' within a tight window (about 150 ms). A broken block leaves you stunned.
* '''Dashing:''' dash and double-dash, with cooldowns, for mobility in a fight.

<!--T:13-->
DMZ ships '''27 base movesets''': sword, katana, claymore, staff, battlestaff, spear, dagger, rapier, scythe, hammer, glaive, halberd, lance, mace, trident, twin blade, fist, claw and more. Weapons from other mods get a sensible moveset guessed from their name.
</translate>
{{See also|Combat|Weapon Attributes}}

<translate>
<!--T:46-->
The same fight plays out very differently depending on the blade: the '''Katana''' chains quick combos, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]] trades speed for heavy crits, and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Power Pole|Power Pole]] wins the spacing game with reach and its spinning finisher.

<!--T:47-->
World boss drop chances are the server defaults (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]). The Tamagamis are the guardians of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Weapons on your back == <!--T:48-->

<!--T:49-->
While you carry the Z Sword, the Brave Sword or the Power Pole in your inventory, it is shown on your character's back.
</translate>

<translate>
== Enchanting weapons == <!--T:50-->

<!--T:51-->
DMZ adds its own weapon enchantments, such as Defense Penetration, Healing Reduction, Critical Chance and Critical Damage. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Enchantments|Enchantments]].
</translate>
